pairs: Peccatum Juda scriptum est stylo ferreo in ungue adamantino,
“The sin of Judah has been written with a pen of iron and a point of diamond.
exaratum super latitudinem cordis eorum, et in cornibus ararum eorum.
It has been engraved upon the breadth of their heart and upon the horns of their shrines.
Cum recordati fuerint filii eorum ararum suarum,
And their sons make a remembrance of their shrines,
and their leafy trees on high mountains,
fortitudinem tuam, et omnes thesauros tuos in direptionem dabo;
And so, I will give over your strength and all your treasures to be despoiled,
excelsa tua propter peccata in universis finibus tuis.
along with your exalted places of sin, within all your borders.
Et relinqueris sola ab hæreditate tua,
And you will be left behind without your inheritance,
et servire te faciam inimicis tuis in terra quam ignoras:
And I will cause you to serve your enemies in a land that you do not know.
quoniam ignem succendisti in furore meo:
For you have kindled a fire in my fury;
it shall burn, even unto eternity.”
Maledictus homo qui confidit in homine,
“Cursed is a man who trusts in man,
and who establishes what is flesh as his right arm,
et a Domino recedit cor ejus.
and whose heart withdraws from the Lord.
Erit enim quasi myricæ in deserto,
For he will be like a saltcedar tree in the desert.
et non videbit cum venerit bonum:
And he will not perceive it, when what is good has arrived.
sed habitabit in siccitate in deserto,
Instead, he will live in dryness, in a desert,
in a land of salt, which is uninhabitable.
Benedictus vir qui confidit in Domino,
Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord,
for the Lord will be his confidence.
Et erit quasi lignum quod transplantatur super aquas,
And he will be like a tree planted beside waters,
quod ad humorem mittit radices suas,
which sends out its roots to moist soil.
et non timebit cum venerit æstus:
And it will not fear when the heat arrives.
And its leaves will be green.
et in tempore siccitatis non erit sollicitum,
And in the time of drought, it will not be anxious,
nor will it cease at any time to bear fruit.
The heart is depraved above all things,
Ego Dominus scrutans cor, et probans renes:
I am the Lord, who examines the heart and tests the temperament,
qui do unicuique juxta viam suam, et juxta fructum adinventionum suarum.
who gives to each one according to his way and according to the fruit of his own decisions.
A partridge has hatched eggs that she did not lay;
fecit divitias, et non in judicio:
a man has gathered riches, but without judgment.
in dimidio dierum suorum derelinquet eas,
In the midst of his days, he will leave it all behind,
et in novissimo suo erit insipiens.
and he will be foolish concerning his very end.”
and glorious throne is the place of our sanctification from the beginning.
all who forsake you will be confounded.
Those who withdraw from you will be written into the earth.
For they have abandoned the Lord,
quoniam dereliquerunt venam aquarum viventium Dominum.
Behold, they themselves are saying to me:
‘Where is the word of the Lord?
et ego non sum turbatus, te pastorem sequens:
But I am not troubled; I am following you as my shepherd.
And I have not desired the day of man,
quod egressum est de labiis meis, rectum in conspectu tuo fuit.
That which has gone forth from my lips has been right in your sight.
May you not be a dread to me.
spes mea tu in die afflictionis.
You are my hope in the day of affliction.
May those who persecute me be confounded,
but may I not be confounded.
and may I not be fearful.
Lead over them the day of affliction,
and crush them with a double destruction.”
Thus says the Lord to me:
et sta in porta filiorum populi,
and stand at the gate of the sons of the people,
through which the kings of Judah enter
and at all the gates of Jerusalem.
And you shall say to them:
Listen to the word of the Lord,
and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
et nolite portare pondera in die sabbati,
and do not choose to carry heavy things on the day of the Sabbath,
nor should you carry these things through the gates of Jerusalem.
et nolite ejicere onera de domibus vestris in die sabbati,
And do not be willing to cast burdens out of your houses on the day of the Sabbath,
nor should you do any work.
Sanctify the day of the Sabbath,
just as I instructed your fathers.
nor did they incline their ear.
lest they listen to me and receive discipline.
ut non inferatis onera per portas civitatis hujus in die sabbati:
so that you do not carry in burdens through the gates of this city on the day of the Sabbath,
and if you sanctify the day of the Sabbath,
ne faciatis in eo omne opus:
so that you do not do work in it,
ingredientur per portas civitatis hujus reges et principes,
then there will enter through the gates of this city:
et ascendentes in curribus et equis,
sitting on the throne of David,
and riding on chariots and horses,
the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
et habitabitur civitas hæc in sempiternum.
And this city will be inhabited forever.
And they will arrive from the cities of Judah
and from the land of Benjamin,
et inferent oblationem in domum Domini.
And they will carry an oblation into the house of the Lord.
Si autem non audieritis me ut sanctificetis diem sabbati,
But if you will not listen to me, to sanctify the day of the Sabbath,
et ne inferatis per portas Jerusalem in die sabbati,
and not to bring these things through the gates of Jerusalem on the day of the Sabbath,
then I will kindle a fire at its gates,
and it will devour the houses of Jerusalem,
and it will not be extinguished.”
